scope: Fresh software build for the ordinary interactive Shelf baseline. No startup measurement, input demonstration, live account, or Kindle hardware result is derived from building an executable.

release.network: Isolated namespace, loopback only; offline Cargo.
release.target_directory: Fresh private /work/target; no previously built application or research fork.

source.verification: The complete staged file roster and every file byte matched a separate literal working-tree archive both before and after the build. Literal checkout line endings, including Git-normalized files, were used. The existing catalog-tests overlay is test-only. No application or renderer source was changed for this baseline.

fixture_helper.role: Separate synthetic-only fixture preparation package. It uses the same frozen application library, with its own copied lockfile adding only the helper package; it is not the measured application.

artifact_verification: Both owner-only executables were atomically installed and compared byte-for-byte to their own Cargo output. Neither is a previously retained study executable.
